set.body:
Scheduling lane: owner. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Governing plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md (2026-09-19); ADR 0019. Key: ciowner; lane: owner.

Scope: GitHub Actions account/runner decision

Acceptance criteria:
1. Record owner choice of billing remediation or a specific permitted runner route; no repository-visibility or spending change is inferred.
2. Push portion complete at baseline: local HEAD, origin/main and live remote main all equal 1113f96864a38a2869e49d9c8c5d4e2dc43f5d10. Preserve this evidence rather than asking again.
3. CI ticket executes the chosen route and verifies tests actually ran; this decision ticket alone is not qualification.

Validation: git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main; owner decision recorded on this issue

Completion evidence: exact baseline/result SHA, executable command and bound test totals/exit, artifact digests, discriminating failure injection, compatibility impact, separate SD6 review. Run reference-scope for the actual diff and SD2 checkAll before landing. Proposed suite names below are acceptance specifications, not existing or executed tests. No efficacy claim follows from a synthetic pass.

Boundary:
set.title: OWNER: choose the CI account or runner route (push already complete)
